OSKAR HADDAD-LINDQVIST
Full-Stack Engineer | React, TypeScript & Node.js

Gothenburg, Sweden | +46 70 555 0808 | oskar.hl@example.com
GitHub: oskarhl-example | Blog: oskar-codes.example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack engineer with 12 years of professional web development experience, strongest in frontend engineering with React and TypeScript. Experienced building patient-facing-adjacent customer onboarding features, Node.js services and SQL-backed applications, with a focus on accessibility, performance and reliable delivery. Delivered a BankID identity verification flow that increased onboarding conversion from 61% to 74%, and improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds. Fluent in English.

CORE SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Angular, AngularJS, React Native, Vue, Storybook, Redux, React Query
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Server BFF maintenance), PHP, Laravel
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma, TypeORM
Testing and delivery: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker
Cloud and tools: AWS (ECS, S3, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, RDS), Linux, Figma, Jira, Confluence, Sentry, Datadog, Unleash
Additional: Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes), BankID integration, Agile/Scrum

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Full-Stack Developer | Älvgrind Fintech AB | Gothenburg
2021–Present
- Build and improve onboarding features in React and TypeScript, with Node.js/NestJS services and PostgreSQL in a six-person cross-functional team.
- Developed a BankID identity verification flow, including QR and same-device flows, error handling and retries. A/B tested the new flow with 10% of traffic before rollout; onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74%.
- Built a customer document-upload flow using S3 presigned URLs, a Lambda-based ClamAV virus scan, and SQS and PostgreSQL to track scan status.
- Improved mobile frontend performance, reducing Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds through code splitting, image optimisation, removing Moment.js and replacing a large charting library.
- Fixed accessibility issues in the onboarding flow following a WCAG 2.1 AA audit.
- Helped incrementally migrate onboarding backend routes from Express to NestJS; migrated the frontend from Create React App to Vite in 2023.
- Maintain a GraphQL BFF with another developer; contribute automated tests using Jest and Playwright and use GitHub Actions for delivery workflows.
- Work closely with designers in Figma, participate in on-call rotation, and have interviewed around 30 candidates.
- Acted as team lead for four months in 2024, covering one-to-ones and sprint planning during the team lead’s parental leave.
- Team received the 2023 internal Customer Impact Award.

Developer | Sjöbris Digital Agency AB | Gothenburg
2018–2021
- Delivered websites and web applications for approximately 25 clients across retail, transport, local government and sport.
- Built client applications using Angular, React and Vue, with Node.js/Express or PHP/Laravel backends, and developed custom WordPress themes and plugins.
- Served as project tech lead and primary app developer on a two-developer React Native ferry-ticket app, supporting ticket purchase and offline access; the app reached approximately 50,000 downloads.
- Set up GitLab CI for the agency, replacing a manual FTP-based deployment process.
- Worked with MySQL, MongoDB and Firebase across client projects.

Web Developer | Nordkust Media AB | Gothenburg
2014–2018
- Developed newspaper websites and an article editor using PHP, jQuery and AngularJS.
- Implemented a paywall integration and worked on Varnish caching configuration and Ubuntu server administration.
- Used MySQL for application data.

Freelance Developer | 2012–2014
- Built websites for friends, family, a local bakery and two bands using PHP, jQuery and WordPress.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Computer Science | West Coast University College (Högskola), Gothenburg | 2011–2014
Graduated 2014

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Advanced React Patterns | Online course | 2022

COMMUNITY
- Mentor at a Gothenburg coding bootcamp, 2019–2020.
- Speaker at a local JavaScript meetup in 2022: “Migrating Express to NestJS without stopping the world.”

LANGUAGES
Swedish: Native | English: Fluent | Arabic: Spoken at home; limited writing | German: Basic, school-level

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Driving licence: Category B
Interests: Climbing, board games, bass guitar and home automation.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear reverse-chronological experience, measurable outcomes, relevant technologies, and credible progression from web development to full-stack engineering. The BankID conversion improvement, LCP reduction, document-upload security controls, mobile-app downloads, and team-lead cover are particularly effective evidence. The document is professional and substantially more targeted than the original material. Minor weaknesses are that some role-specific concepts are only implied rather than explicitly stated, and the phrase "patient-facing-adjacent" is awkward and potentially confusing because the experience was customer onboarding rather than patient software.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is strong: the CV uses standard section headings, text-based formatting, clear dates, conventional company/title entries, and highly relevant keywords including React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Jest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, AWS, Docker, Storybook, accessibility, and A/B testing. It should have a high AI/ATS screening probability for this role because the principal technology stack and most must-have requirements appear directly in the document. The main limitations are that semantic HTML, responsive layouts, OWASP Top 10, GDPR/health-data privacy, and explicit unit/integration-test terminology are not clearly represented. These should not be added unless supported by the candidate's actual experience.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is very strong for the core engineering work. The CV clearly demonstrates more than two years of React and TypeScript experience, Node.js/NestJS backend development, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, automated testing, Git-based delivery, accessibility audit work, Next.js, Storybook, and analytics/A/B testing. BankID identity verification, KYC onboarding, secure document upload, ClamAV scanning, and fintech experience provide relevant evidence of authentication, security-conscious development, and work in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment. Collaboration with designers, sprint-planning leadership, interviewing, mentoring, and cross-functional work also fit the small patient-experience squad. The candidate's material does not establish OWASP Top 10 awareness, willingness to learn health-data privacy requirements, or healthcare/wellness experience; these are genuine profile gaps rather than CV-writing defects. German is described as basic and largely forgotten, so it is not a meaningful customer-facing advantage.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL: None.

MINOR, HIGH-VALUE ENHANCEMENTS:
1. In the Professional Summary, replace "Experienced building patient-facing-adjacent customer onboarding features" with a precise truthful phrase such as "Experienced building customer onboarding and identity-verification features." This removes awkward wording and avoids implying healthcare or patient-product experience that is not documented.
2. In the Professional Summary, change "with a focus on accessibility, performance and reliable delivery" to a more evidence-based phrase such as "with a focus on WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility fixes, mobile performance, automated testing and reliable delivery." This connects the summary directly to documented achievements and job-relevant keywords.
3. In the Core Skills section under "Testing and delivery," change the testing list to "Unit and end-to-end testing: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest" and retain the GitHub Actions and GitLab CI tools afterward. This makes the unit-testing and end-to-end-testing requirement easier for ATS and recruiters to identify without adding unsupported experience.
4. In the current Älvgrind role, revise the BankID bullet to include the existing authentication context, for example: "Developed a BankID identity-verification and authentication flow, including QR and same-device flows, error handling and retries." Use this only as a clarification of the documented BankID integration, not as a claim of broader authentication-platform ownership.
5. In the current Älvgrind role, revise the document-upload bullet to foreground the existing security controls: "Built a secure customer document-upload flow using S3 presigned URLs, Lambda-based ClamAV virus scanning, SQS and PostgreSQL to track scan status." This improves alignment with the advertisement's security emphasis while staying within the original candidate information.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- “contribute automated tests using Jest and Playwright” — the candidate’s material lists Jest and Playwright as technologies used, but does not specifically support contributing automated tests.
unsupported_claims: “contribute automated tests using Jest and Playwright” — the candidate’s material lists Jest and Playwright as technologies used, but does not specifically support contributing automated tests.

OSKAR HADDAD-LINDQVIST
Full-Stack Engineer | React, TypeScript & Node.js

Gothenburg, Sweden | +46 70 555 0808 | oskar.hl@example.com
GitHub: https://github.com/oskarhl-example | Blog: https://oskar-codes.example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack engineer with 12 years of professional web development experience, strongest in frontend engineering with React and TypeScript. Experienced building customer onboarding and identity-verification features, Node.js services and SQL-backed applications, with a focus on WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility fixes, mobile performance and automated testing. Delivered a BankID identity verification flow that increased onboarding conversion from 61% to 74%, and improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds. Fluent in English.

CORE SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Angular, AngularJS, React Native, Vue, Storybook, Redux, React Query
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Server BFF maintenance), PHP, Laravel
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma, TypeORM
Testing: Unit and end-to-end testing with Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, and Supertest | Delivery: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker
Cloud and tools: AWS (ECS, S3, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, RDS), Linux, Figma, Jira, Confluence, Sentry, Datadog, Unleash
Additional: Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes), BankID integration, Agile/Scrum

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Full-Stack Developer | Älvgrind Fintech AB | Gothenburg
2021–Present
- Build and improve onboarding features in React and TypeScript, with Node.js/NestJS services and PostgreSQL in a six-person cross-functional team.
- Developed a BankID identity-verification flow, including QR and same-device flows, error handling and retries. A/B tested the new flow with 10% of traffic before rollout; onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74%.
- Built a secure customer document-upload flow using S3 presigned URLs, Lambda-based ClamAV virus scanning, SQS and PostgreSQL to track scan status.
- Improved mobile frontend performance, reducing Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds through code splitting, image optimisation, removing Moment.js and replacing a large charting library.
- Fixed accessibility issues in the onboarding flow following a WCAG 2.1 AA audit.
- Helped incrementally migrate onboarding backend routes from Express to NestJS; migrated the frontend from Create React App to Vite in 2023.
- Maintain a GraphQL BFF with another developer; use GitHub Actions for delivery workflows.
- Work closely with designers in Figma, participate in on-call rotation, and have interviewed around 30 candidates.
- Acted as team lead for four months in 2024, covering one-to-ones and sprint planning during the team lead’s parental leave.
- Team received the 2023 internal Customer Impact Award.

Developer | Sjöbris Digital Agency AB | Gothenburg
2018–2021
- Delivered websites and web applications for approximately 25 clients across retail, transport, local government and sport.
- Built client applications using Angular, React and Vue, with Node.js/Express or PHP/Laravel backends, and developed custom WordPress themes and plugins.
- Served as project tech lead and primary app developer on a two-developer React Native ferry-ticket app, supporting ticket purchase and offline access; the app reached approximately 50,000 downloads.
- Set up GitLab CI for the agency, replacing a manual FTP-based deployment process.
- Worked with MySQL, MongoDB and Firebase across client projects.

Web Developer | Nordkust Media AB | Gothenburg
2014–2018
- Developed newspaper websites and an article editor using PHP, jQuery and AngularJS.
- Implemented a paywall integration and worked on Varnish caching configuration and Ubuntu server administration.
- Used MySQL for application data.

Freelance Developer | 2012–2014
- Built websites for friends, family, a local bakery and two bands using PHP, jQuery and WordPress.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Computer Science | West Coast University College (Högskola), Gothenburg | 2011–2014
Graduated 2014

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Advanced React Patterns | Online course | 2022

COMMUNITY
- Mentor at a Gothenburg coding bootcamp, 2019–2020.
- Speaker at a local JavaScript meetup in 2022: “Migrating Express to NestJS without stopping the world.”

LANGUAGES
Swedish: Native | English: Fluent | Arabic: Spoken at home; limited writing | German: Basic, school-level

Driving licence: Category B
Interests: Climbing, board games, bass guitar and home automation.
